pivot_arithmetic: exact rational coefficients and fixed-point comparisons; no float contact tolerance
atr_seed: mean of first 14 true ranges; first TR=high-low
calendar: study-derived historical regimes; pinned conservative holiday rule set
calendar_certification: regime notices verified; annual individual schedules not independently certified
mapping_certification: vendor previous-day-volume semantics; retained map lacks original publication/arrival times
mapping_sensitivity: exclude first two scheduled weekdays of each mapping interval; historical diagnostic, not causal reconstruction
policy_ambiguity: two complete occupancy replays: stop-first and target-first; envelopes apply to these assumptions, not all hypothetical schedules
missing_policy: unresolved session excluded from continuous policy mean; missing outcomes never zero
seed_gate: 250 preceding nonempty bars within reset segment, >=99% expected minutes in window; no unknown >5-minute gap
strict_gate: 100% prior session and last 250 preceding bars
prior_day: immediately previous weekday; holiday/shortened weekday remains invalid, conservative no older-day substitution
retrospective_exclusions: source-condition degradation current/prior day; scheduled holiday sample selection
